title: CAN tutorial chapters 28–30 — evidence ledger
source_policy: Vendor/documentation sources for normative behavior; all numeric traffic/current examples are derived teaching assumptions, not measurements.

28.scope: Classical CAN 11-bit data frames with 0–8 bytes, STM32F1 bxCAN example, private protocol not CANopen

claims.statement: CAN's bitwise priority arbitration lets lower-priority senders wait rather than corrupting the winning arbitration frame
With intermission and without bit stuffing, a standard Classical CAN data frame takes 47+8*DLC bits, or 111 bits with DLC 8
claims.locator: Classical CAN standard data frame fields; bit counts shown in 28.3

claims.statement: 8 nodes × 50 frames/s × assumed 130 bits/frame at 500 kbit/s = 10.4% estimated payload traffic bus occupancy
CANopen heartbeat and SYNC have a predefined connection-set context; a raw project cannot silently reuse their semantics

29.scope: Transceiver low-power behavior is part-specific; PN example only models standard 11-bit WUF ID matching

claims.statement: Selective wake-up/partial networking requires supporting transceiver hardware
Normal CAN wake-up pattern differs from valid wake-up frame matching
claims.locator: Wake-up frame concept; exact implementation varies by part

claims.statement: 50 uA sleep and 20 mA active at 1% duty gives 249.5 uA time-weighted average
sleep/wake hooks in chapter are abstract and not verified TJA1145 register addresses

30.scope: STM32F103 bxCAN nominal bitrate example with PCLK1=36 MHz; Linux SocketCAN host as example; not hardware certification

claims.statement: HAL_CAN_AddTxMessage enqueues into transmit mailbox; other APIs handle completion, errors and sleep
python-can uses can.Bus(channel='can0', interface='socketcan') for SocketCAN
Little-endian <hHHBB example -1234/2500/1450/7/1 yields 2E FB C4 09 AA 05 07 01
Do not assume 0–5 V sensors can directly connect to a 3.3 V-class STM32 ADC without proper signal conditioning
claims.locator: 30.html §30.3; device datasheet and board schematic must be consulted

verification.status: pending CI execution; no hardware validation claimed
